authorization.basis: Option G post-hoc analysis supports boundary smoothing; active goal authorizes continued VISION-aligned synthetic work.
authorization.scope: one synthetic-only smooth local-forward and inverse-closure candidate

plant_and_sensory: exact frozen Option F five-gesture plant and 30-value 150-5000 Hz normalized sensory representation

babbling_memory.stored_per_exemplar: five motor coordinates and 30 sensory coordinates

smooth_local_predictor.neighbor_selection: 64 minimum Euclidean motor distances; lower babbling ordinal breaks ties
smooth_local_predictor.bandwidth: distance to the 64th neighbor; fail if nonpositive
smooth_local_predictor.fit: weighted six-by-six affine ridge solve per query
smooth_local_predictor.query_prediction: fitted intercept, mean centered and L2 normalized

forward_gate.distance: Euclidean distance between unit 30-value sensory vectors
baselines: previous held-out sensory or neutral for first

inverse.anchor_subset: every eighth babbling exemplar starting with ordinal zero, exactly 256 anchors
inverse.initialization: anchor with minimum stored sensory half-distance; effort then lower anchor ordinal break ties

inverse_targets.selection: unique minimum canonical relative formant RMSE for a/e/i/o/u from the frozen target pool; lower Halton index breaks ties
inverse_targets.trials: five target motors crossed with F0 90,110,140,180 Hz

decision_rule: Checkpoint implementation before opening held-out or target ranges and execute once. Any failure is retained without changing exemplars, neighbor count, kernel, ridge, anchors, search, points, or gates.
promotion_boundary: A full pass is synthetic-only evidence for this local smooth shared representation. It does not promote H4 or authorize recorded speech.
